description: Yasutoshi Moteki at Nanzan University publishes R scripts for recording and replaying Japanese bus operations from GTFS-Realtime feeds. The June 2026 deposit includes static-data preprocessing, a sixty-second logger, a playback application and a short Hiroshima vehicle-position example in RDS and GeoJSON. Examples also cover Tokyo Toei and Chita Aiai buses. Files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0; upstream transit feeds have separate access terms. These tools can build observed operations inputs or compare schedules with realised vehicle positions in transport simulations. They are not independently calibrated traffic-flow models. Feed registration and rate limits vary, and the provider’s claims of flawless performance were not verified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workflow. Code and live feeds were not executed, and example representativeness remains uncertain.
